sentences.text:
Jawahir Lal And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14
March, 2023

Author: Sunita Agarwal
Bench: Sunita Agarwal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 39
Case :- Writ - C No. - 3181 of 2023
Petitioner :- Jawahir Lal And 8 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sharad Shekhar Sharma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
The petitioners herein claim that the land-in-question, recorded in their name, namely Gata No.336Gha, area 0.1820 hectares (0.45 acres), had been acquired by the acquisition notification under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, published on 19.11.1983.

The possession of the land-in-question had been taken by the competent authority and a Bhuwalpur Minor had been constructed thereon but no compensation has been paid to the father of the petitioner No.1 herein despite repeated requests made by him.
The entry in the names of the petitioners of Gata No.336Gha area 0.1820 hectares is of the year 1425-30 Fasli.
It is an admitted fact of the matter that the said land was acquired in the year 1983 and possession had been taken.

In none of the paragraphs of the writ petition, the petitioners Jawahir Lal And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78863404/
1 disclosed the date of death of father of the petitioner No.1 in whose name allegedly the land-in-question was recorded.
The entries of the name of the tenure holders at the time of acquisition of land-in-question is not before us.

entities.text: Jawahir Lal And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: No mandamus, as such, can be issued.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
It is open for the petitioners to lay their claim before the competent authority for disbursement of compensation for the land-in-question, if not already disbursed to the original tenure holders.
